label: Dunbaria-inspired band-winged insect
scope: Original stylized child-friendly scene prop inspired by inventory taxon. Not scientific reconstruction. No inventory approval or publication.
design: Four broad tapering main wings in two distinct pairs, plus two MUCH smaller hardened heart-shaped prothoracic lobes forward of main wings, six jointed legs, segmented abdomen, slender downward-forward beak, paired antennae and long trailing cerci. Ochre thorax, honey cream wings with coherent brown cross bands; sparse raised veins. Never six equal-sized true wings.
concept_interpretation: Concept side hides far wings/legs. Build all four main wings and exactly six walking legs. Make small front lobes cordate and isolated rather than an equal third wing pair. Sparse generic veins, artistic bands and approximate scale; no exact sex/species or venation reconstruction asserted.
